Definition: a primary particle; without:--without. Compare G1.
BiblicalUsage: Without. Two sparrows fall not without the Father, and wives may be won without a word by the conversation of their husbands. The word marks the absence of something, a thing done apart from another.
TheologicalSignificance: A small particle for without carries no doctrine of its own; its comfort is Jesus', that not even a sparrow falls apart from the Father.
